'''Soul Fysh''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Soul Fysh}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Beckon
|Intent = StatusCard
|Effect = Shuffles 2 {{C2|Beckon}} into your deck (1 into draw pile, 1 into discard pile).
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = De-Gas
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Gaze
|Intent = Attack2, StatusCard
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage. Shuffles 1 {{C2|Beckon}} into your discard pile.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Fade
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Intangible}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Intangible
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Scream
|Intent = Attack3, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage. Applies 3 {{BD2|Vulnerable}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Vulnerable
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Soul Fysh repeats the same five moves in order:
# {{Int2|Soul Fysh|Beckon}}
# {{Int2|Soul Fysh|De-Gas}}
# {{Int2|Soul Fysh|Gaze}}
# {{Int2|Soul Fysh|Fade}}
# {{Int2|Soul Fysh|Scream}}

== Notes ==
* The first iteration of {{Int2|Soul Fysh|Fade}}'s {{BD2|Intangible}} fades instantly during the transition from {{2|Soul Fysh}}'s turn to the player's. It effectively gains just 1 {{BD2|Intangible}}.

== Useful Cards ==
* Anything which can get rid of {{C2|Beckon}} without playing it can be useful. Transforming or exhausting it through cards like {{C2|Fiend Fire}} or {{C2|BEGONE!}} is best because it will be permanently removed rather than simply being put into the discard pile, but discarding it with cards like {{C2|Prepared}} or {{C2|Hidden Daggers}} can still save {{KW2|Energy}} compared to playing it normally.
* Cards like {{C2|No Escape}}  which apply {{BD2|Doom}} rather than dealing damage can ignore {{BD2|Intangible}}.
